content_sections.heading: ONGC Videsh Industrial Training Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the location, ICAI examination, HSC marks and date-of-birth requirements stated by ONGC Videsh. Candidates must be based in the Delhi/NCR region. Candidates must have passed one of the prescribed ICAI examinations. Candidates must have secured a minimum of 70% marks in HSC (12th). Candidates must have been born on or after 01 January 2003. Eligibility and other terms for Industrial Training will be governed by ICAI regulations.

faq.question: Q1. What is ONGC Videsh Industrial Training Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ONGC Videsh Limited has invited eligible ICAI candidates for an Industrial Training opportunity lasting between 9 and 12 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many seats are available for ONGC Videsh Industrial Training 2026?
Q3. What is the last date to apply for ONGC Videsh Industrial Training 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 04 September 2026, Friday.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ONGC Videsh Industrial Training 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the prescribed ICAI Intermediate/IPC, Professional Competence or Professional Education Examination-II and must have secured at least 70% in HSC (12th).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notification gives a date-of-birth condition rather than an age range. Candidates must have been born on or after 01 January 2003.

faq.question: Q6. What is the ONGC Videsh Industrial Training stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.25,000 per month, consolidated.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must complete the prescribed Google Form, upload the required documents and submit the application by 04 September 2026.
